name: Interactive reports: bookmarks, drillthrough, tooltips, field parameters

steps: Create page "Customer Detail" with a drillthrough field CustomerName. Add a table of their orders, a card for their Net Sales, and a line chart by date.
Turn on "Keep all filters". Add a back button (auto-created) and style it.
From the summary page, right-click a customer bar → Drillthrough. Verify the Region slicer selection is carried over.
Add a second drillthrough field ProductName to the same page and observe it now requires either.
asg.exp: Right-click menu shows "Customer Detail". Back button returns to the source page.

steps: New page, Page information → Allow use as tooltip, size Tooltip.
Add a card Net Sales, a small bar chart of SubCategory, and a text measure "X orders, Y customers".
On the summary page, set the Category bar chart Tooltip → Report page → your page.
asg.exp: Hovering over "Water" shows Water-only numbers inside the tooltip.

asg.t: Field parameters for a self-service chart
steps: Modeling → New parameter → Fields. Add Net Sales, Orders, Margin %, Total Qty as one parameter "Measure Picker".
Create a second field parameter "Axis Picker" with Category, RegionName, Segment, MonthName.
One clustered bar chart driven by both parameters, two slicers to switch them.
asg.exp: Sixteen chart combinations from one visual. Look at the generated DAX for the parameter table and explain the third column.

steps: Two visuals stacked exactly on top of each other: a column chart and a table of the same data.
Two bookmarks "Show chart" / "Show table" that only change Display (Data and Current page unchecked), created with the Selection pane.
Two buttons whose visible state is swapped by the same bookmarks so the active one looks pressed.
Group the four objects and name the group; ungroup and note what happens to the bookmarks.
asg.exp: Clicking either button never resets slicers. Bookmarks have Data unchecked.

steps: Title measure = "Net sales for " & IF(ISFILTERED(DimRegion[RegionName]), SELECTEDVALUE(DimRegion[RegionName], "multiple regions"), "all regions") & " – " & FORMAT(MAX(Dates[Date]), "MMM yyyy").
Use it as the fx title on a chart.
Colour measure = IF([Margin %] < 0.4, "#B23A2E", "#1F7A4D") used as fx on a bar colour.
asg.exp: Title changes with the slicer. Bars change colour without conditional formatting rules.

int.q: Bookmark "Data" checkbox: when do you leave it on, when off?
int.a: On when the bookmark is meant to restore a filter state (a saved view). Off when it only toggles visibility or a visual swap; otherwise the user's slicer selections reset every time they click the button.

int.q: Drillthrough vs tooltip vs drill down: when each?
int.a: Drill down: same visual, hierarchy levels. Drillthrough: navigate to a detail page for one item. Tooltip page: peek at detail without leaving. Choose the least disruptive one that answers the question.

int.q: What is the hidden third column in a field parameter table used for?
int.a: It is the sort/order column (and there is also the field reference stored via NAMEOF). You can add more columns, e.g. a group column, to build grouped slicers.

int.q: How do you conditionally show a visual based on a slicer selection?
int.a: Field parameters or a measure-driven visual filter (e.g. a measure returning 1 or 0 as a visual-level filter) or bookmarks. Visuals cannot be hidden by a measure directly; use a transparent overlay shape whose fill is a colour measure with 0% alpha, or the page-navigation trick.

int.q: Why is a 30-visual page slow even though the model is small?
int.a: Each visual issues at least one query and they compete for the formula engine; slicers with cross-filtering issue queries per interaction. Reduce visuals, combine cards into one multi-row card or matrix, disable unnecessary interactions.

o: Slicers on the target page are locked
Filters from the source page context are carried over
Filters are saved to a bookmark
ass.why: It passes the full filter context of the clicked data point, not only the drillthrough field.

o: A calculated table with NAMEOF references usable in visuals
ass.why: Field parameters are calculated tables with special metadata.

ass.q: Build a page where one button toggles between "Actual" and "Budget" in a single matrix without resetting any slicer. Prove it by selecting Region = East, toggling twice, and confirming East stays selected.
ass.hint: Two bookmarks with Data unchecked, or one field parameter slicer styled as buttons.

ass.q: Which formatting property can be driven by a measure returning a hex colour?
o: Most colour properties with an fx button, including bar colours and titles
ass.why: Any property with fx accepts a field value.
